brief:
State Senator Scott Wiener, a candidate for California's 11th Congressional District, recently stated his support for a Gaza ceasefire in late 2023, Drop Site News reported. However, the claim conflicts with his documented opposition to a local ceasefire resolution in San Francisco during that same period.

Wiener actively lobbied against the San Francisco measure while publicly asserting his ceasefire position, according to the outlet's reporting. The discrepancy raises questions about the consistency of his stated position on ending the conflict.
dek: The candidate for California’s 11th Congressional District recently said that he supported a ceasefire in late 2023. At the time, he lobbied against a local ceasefire resolution in San Francisco.
title: Wiener's Gaza stance contradicts recent ceasefire claim
